Subject: Re: HealthBridge RFP HB-1193 — technical appendix draft + artifacts

Hi all — attaching the initial technical appendix and a network/dataflow diagram. Highlights below: 

- KV cache handling: caches are in-memory on serving nodes and ephemeral; no disk-backed cache for prefix caches. When a model instance is scaled down, KV cache is zeroed. We document TTL and eviction behavior and how we avoid cross-tenant leakage.
- Encryption: all customer data at rest is AES-256 encrypted. Keys are held in a customer-tenant-specific KMS envelope; for Private deployments customers can supply KMIP/HSM. Key rotation is on a quarterly schedule for root keys; data keys rotate per-tenant every 90 days.
- Transfer mechanisms: for EU/UK->US, we support SCCs (with controller-letter) and supplemental technical measures: encryption-in-flight, per-tenant envelope keys, and access control proofing. For hosted customers we also offer Dedicated pools in region to avoid cross-border export.
- Subprocessors: list attached (redacted). We include standard subprocessor agreement language and the DPA annex link.

Attachments: [redwood-dpf-technical-appendix.pdf (PDF)], [network-dataflow-diagram.png (PNG)], [subprocessors-redacted.csv (CSV)]

I'll incorporate any wording edits from Laura. If HealthBridge prefers a signed standalone controller-letter vs. our DPA annex, Laura can advise.

--
Monica Patel
Director, Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-dpf-technical-appendix.pdf (PDF); network-dataflow-diagram.png (PNG); subprocessors-redacted.csv (CSV)]
